title: Evaluation of Xilinx Deep Learning Processing Unit under Neutron Irradiation
reasoning: The paper is a technical study focused on the dependability of a hardware component (Xilinx Deep-Learning Processing Unit) when exposed to neutron irradiation. It analyzes hardware faults (Single Event Effects) and their impact on the accuracy of a Convolutional Neural Network. The content is strictly related to computer engineering and physics, with no discussion of religion, morals, or ethics.
